title: Cart rules
summary: Thresholds, gifts and other cart alterations. checkout.quote priority 10 so it runs before vouchers and loyalty. Permission cart_rules.

blocks.title: Priority 10
blocks.text: Cart-rules mutate the quote first. Vouchers 20, loyalty 30. ExtraLines and plugins[tuucho-commerce-cart-rules] feed later filters.
Admin CRUD is the Cart rules page, not Configure. Disable hides admin and checkout alterations.
